title: Jumping 1 or 2
source_text: For a given array $A$ of size $N$, define $f(A)$ in the following way: - A sequence $b_1, b_2, \ldots, b_{|b|}$ is said to be valid if the following conditions hold: - $b_1 = 1$ - $b_{|b|} = N$ - $1 \le b_i - b_{i - 1} \le 2$ - The score of a sequence $b$ is $\sum(A_{b_i})$. - $f(A)$ is the minimum possible score of a valid sequence. Given integers $N$ and $M$, find the sum of $f(A)$ over all sequences $A$ satisfying: - $|A| = N$ - $1 \le A_i \le M$ Since the answer may be large, output it modulo $998244353$. Input - The first line of input will contain a single integer $T$, denoting the number of test cases. - The first and only line of each test case contains $2$ integers $N$ and $M$. Output For each test case, output on a new line the sum of $f(A)$ over all such arrays modulo $998244353$. Constraints - $1 \le T \le 50$ - $2 \le N \le 400$ - $1 \le M \le 400$ - The sum of $N$ over all test cases does not exceed $400$. Sample Input 8 2 1 2 2 3 2 4 2 4 3 4 6 5 3 300 300 Sample Output 2 12 24 68 450 12348 1449 247899749
